caption:
Comment EBOOK and I'll send you the full Faceless AI Affiliate ebook. 🔒

Your first 30 posts are not a performance. They're research.

Results stay flat while the back catalogue builds, then they compound. Almost everyone quits at week three — during the flat part, right before the curve turns. That's not a verdict on the model, it's a verdict on the timing of their patience.

The loop:

1. Batch ten posts in one sitting, one format.
2. Publish daily. Don't rewrite the plan mid-week.
3. Read saves and comments — not likes.
4. Repeat whatever moved. Retire the rest.

Saves mean someone intends to come back. Comments are what the algorithm rewards hardest. Sends mean one person vouched for you to another. Likes tell you almost nothing.
